subject: Money
title: Financial Literacy Gap
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Financial Literacy Gap.

hook.text: Only 33% of adults worldwide can answer three basic financial questions about interest, inflation, and risk.

buildup.text: Most bubble victims aren't greedy—they're uninformed. They buy because others buy, not because they understand.

discovery.text: Countries with mandatory financial education—Australia, Japan—have lower rates of consumer fraud and debt default.

twist.text: Financial education alone can't prevent bubbles. Even experts like Citigroup's CEO said you have to keep dancing.

climax.text: Literacy helps individuals but not systems. Bubbles are collective phenomena that override individual knowledge.

punchline.text: Know the math. Still feel the herd.

quiz.question: Can financial literacy alone prevent bubbles?
options: Yes, educated investors never lose money
No, bubbles are collective phenomena that override individual knowledge
Yes, but only in developed countries
